question: What is the difference between unit, integration, and end-to-end testing?
intendedUser: Professional in Track-A with early-career experience
description: Technical interview question for Track-A professionals.
exampleAnswer: Unit tests test individual functions in isolation. Integration tests test interactions between components. E2E tests test complete user flows. In my project, I used Jest for units (auth service), Supertest for integration (API endpoints), and Cypress for E2E (login → dashboard → logout). Each level catches different bug types.
